[SWS_DM_01058] Optional stopping PDIDs after security level change
⌈
If
DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifierClass.check-
PerSourceId is set to TRUE and the DM is changing the security level session, the
DM shall remove all PDIDs from the list of scheduled PDIDs that are not allowed to be
read in the new security level.
